code.r:
# manifestme.R  (writes manifest.json)
rsconnect::writeManifest(
  appMode = "api",
  appPrimaryDoc = "exemplars/api-plumber/plumber.R"
)

# deployme.R  (bundle, upload, restore, start)
rsconnect::deployAPI(api = ".", appPrimaryDoc = "exemplars/api-plumber/plumber.R")
# Connect Vars: ALLOWED_ORIGIN is set
# Connect Runtime: min processes = 1

# testme.R  (health check)
httr2::request(paste0(base, "/health")) %>%
  httr2::req_perform()

# what Connect does with this bundle
manifest = fromJSON("manifest.json")
needed = c("plumber", "dplyr", "readr", "sf", "jsonlite")
env_vars = c(ALLOWED_ORIGIN = "https://sts.example.edu")
min_processes = 1
idle = FALSE

failed = case_when(
  !(manifest$metadata$entrypoint %in% names(manifest$files)) ~ "upload",
  length(setdiff(needed, names(manifest$packages))) > 0 ~ "start",
  !("ALLOWED_ORIGIN" %in% names(env_vars)) ~ "start",
  TRUE ~ "none"
)

steps = c("bundle", "upload", "restore", "start", "health")
tibble(
  steps_ok = if (failed == "none") 5 else match(failed, steps) - 1,
  failed_step = failed,
  first_response_s = case_when(
    failed != "none" ~ 0,
    min_processes == 0 & idle ~ 8.4 + 0.15,
    TRUE ~ 0.15
  )
)
